scientific.integrity: The epoch map is derived directly from the published update and proved by summing an affine matrix recurrence. The executable checks only algebraic consistency and is not used as an infinite or originality certificate.
limitations: Deterministic one-component quadratic specialization with h identically zero.
Exact one-epoch termination for every start is classified only for isotropic Hessians; a single parameter cancels at most one admissible eigenspace in the anisotropic case.
The finite-termination tuning can be outside the sufficient condition of the source general convergence theorem while remaining within Algorithm 1 stated stepsize range.
The closest NMSVRG predecessor was available only through a publisher preview and abstract, leaving a residual literature risk.

title: One-notch spectral filtering and exact one-epoch termination in MNMPSVRG
